biotools.summary: The adaptr package simulates adaptive clinical trials using Bayesian statistical frameworks, incorporating adaptive stopping, arm dropping, and randomisation. It was developed within the INCEPT project and is primarily supported by Sygeforsikringen ‘danmark’.
